description: Learn how to check the grace period after visa cancellation in UAE. Understand the steps for a smooth transition.

contentHtml:
If you are in the UAE and have to cancel your visa, it is important to know about the grace period. That is, the time you have to stay in the country after going through this process. The grace period after visa cancellation in UAE lasts 2, 3, and 6 months. To verify the grace period after your visa you have to follow some very simple steps. In principle, you have to know that this process has to be carried out through the ICP portal.

In this article, we will explore how to check the grace period after visa cancellation in UAE. First, we will discuss the fines or penalties for exceeding the grace period and the consequences of not complying with the regulations. In addition, we will give you a step-by-step guide on how to carry out the verification process. Read on to learn everything you need about the grace period after visa cancellation in UAE.

 

What was the grace period after the cancellation of the visa in the UAE

 

The after visa cancellation in UAE new rules establish that there is no longer a grace period for visa holders. In this way, now the duration of the stay will be determined by the type of visa in the UAE. This can be 30 or 60 days. Previously, only Dubai granted the grace period, but this policy was also suspended.

In this way, those who fail to comply with the visa cancellation grace period will have a fine of 50 dirhams per day. However, that is the grace period. The grace period is the additional time given to people after their visa expires or is canceled. Thanks to this, they can remain legally in the country without facing any sanctions or consequences.

During this period, people must decide whether to renew their visa, apply for a new one, or leave the country. Additionally, the length of the grace period varies according to the type of visa and the regulations that the government establishes. For this reason, people need to know and respect this grace period and thus ensure compliance with UAE immigration laws.

An example of the length of the grace period is the fact that UAE residents have access to longer grace periods. In this way, they can count on a 6-month grace period after visa cancellation in UAE.

 

How you can Check UAE Visa Cancellation Grace Period online

It is important to know how to check grace period after visa cancellation. For this reason, below, we will indicate all the steps so that you can carry out this process successfully.

 

Step 1: Determine Your Visa Type

The first step to check the grace period after visa cancellation in UAE is to select your visa type. The United Arab Emirates provides different types of visas. For instance, residence visas, work visas, and tourist visas. It is important to know that each type of visa has a grace period after visa cancellation in the UAE.

If you are not sure what your visa type is, you can check your passport or residence permit. This way, you can obtain more information about the visa you have available.

Below, you will see a brief description of the most common types of visas that exist in the UAE.

Tourist visas: If you want to visit the UAE for tourism or leisure reasons, you need a tourist visa. The tourist visa can provide multiple entries. In addition, it is valid for 1 to 3 months, depending on the holder’s specific visa.

Residence visa: Investors, entrepreneurs, students, professionals, or retirees can obtain a residence visa. Specifically, those who want to stay for a longer stay in the country. Certain types of golden visas grant permanent residence privileges to eligible candidates.

Student visas: In the UAE, students have the opportunity to obtain a student visa for a university or college. To be eligible, applicants must be at least 18 years old and with a sponsoring institution. The other option is to have a parent residing in the country who can act as your sponsor. The initial validity for this type of visa is one year but can be extended if you show evidence of continued enrollment.

Investor visa: Thanks to the investor visa in Dubai, investors can make investments in properties or businesses in the UAE. In addition, they will have access to exclusive benefits.

 

Step 2: Visit the GDRFA

When determining your visa type, you need to proceed to visit the GDRFA website. That is, from the General Directorate of Residency and Foreign Affairs (GDRFA). The GDRFA is a government agency whose purpose is to manage visas and immigration in the UAE. On the website, you can find different services for visa holders. For instance, verification of the grace period after visa cancellation in UAE.

In other words, this entity regulates the entry and exit of international travelers and the residence of foreign citizens. Every year, the agency processes applications from thousands of visitors to the UAE. In addition, it is competent for being among the main border and port addresses in the world.

 

Step 3: Click on the “Services” Tab

After accessing the GDRFA web portal, you have to click on the Services tab. You can find it in the top menu bar of the website. This will take you to a drop-down menu that has several options with all the services available.

Next, we will show you a brief description of the services you can find.

Family Book services: The GDRFA must deal with everything regarding the Family Book. That is, book modification services linked to marriage or separation, replacing a lost or damaged book, adding a newborn child to the books, and more.

Passport Services: Passport services of GDRFA include the replacement of a lost passport and, the issuance of a passport for a foreign wife. Additionally, there is the issuance of an electronic passport and the renewal of passports.

Entry permit services: Another GDRFA service is residence entry permit applications. That is, they handle short or long-visit visa applications. In addition, extensions or cancellations of a visit visa.

Residence services: If you are a person who wants a new residence visa, you have to enter the GDRFA web portal. It also applies to people who wish to renew or update their residence permit.

Border control services: All entries through air, sea, or land ports are guarded and registered by the GDRFA.

 

Step 4: Select the “Visa Services” Option

In the services drop-down menu, you have to select the visa services option. Afterward, you will be redirected to the visa services page. On this page, you will be able to access a variety of services regarding visas. This applies to any type of visa, except for the residence visa where you have to seek residency services.

 

Step 5: Click on the “Inquiry and Follow-up on Canceled Residence Visas” Option

Once you are on the visa services page, you need to click on the canceled residence visa inquiry and follow-up option. Additionally, this service allows people to verify the status of their canceled visas. There is even a grace period for canceling the visa.

 

Step 6: Enter Your Details

After you have clicked on the option to consult and follow up on canceled residence visas; You will be directed to a page where you can enter all your data. In this way, you will need to provide your date of birth, nationality, and residence file number. Having entered all your data, you only have to click on the send button.

 

Conclusion

If you cancel your UAE visa, you must know the grace period you have to stay in the country. Additionally, the grace period after cancellation has been extended to 2, 3, or up to 6 months depending on the type of visa and the circumstances. This way, if you want to check the grace period after cancellation you can follow the simple steps mentioned above.

Throughout the article, you see about the grace period and how you can verify it. In addition, you read about the fines for exceeding this grace period and the consequences of not complying with the regulations. Here at Connect Group, we have visa services that can be very useful to you.
